what_it_does: The Preconditioned Conjugate Gradient (PCG) method is a fundamental algorithm for solving large linear systems that arise in scientific computing. The s-step variant reduces synchronization overhead (communication between processors) by batching multiple computation steps, but this makes numerical accuracy more fragile and dependent on which basis (method of representation) is chosen. This paper develops a generalized s-step PCG framework that supports any basis type and comprehensively compares all variants.
